integration_gate: The schema-v2/workflow prerequisite is complete, but these rows remain reference-only pending reviewed account onboarding. Do not auto-import them into config/obligation_accounts.json, config/orgs.json, or any workflow, and do not remap production accounts; resolved rows may be evaluated independently of provisional and unresolved rows.

classification_definitions.resolved: Account identity is supported by an exact official title/code match or by an AAAS field that unambiguously scopes program lines to that account; explicit totals may map to several accounts.
classification_definitions.provisional: The cited account candidates are defensible, but the AAAS label lacks a service, program-element, or historical split needed for final integration.
classification_definitions.unresolved: No defensible current federal account follows from the label, or the label is intentionally an analytical grouping rather than an account.
